title: Command Option Parser

oracle.positive: Option parser reads length=2.5mm angle=90deg from typed descriptors
oracle.negative: Unknown options, malformed numeric, NaN/Infinity report parse error

reviewer.role: plan gate: this item requires no manual test
reviewer.statement: The plan records manual_test_gate=AUTO_ONLY for every L3 of OM9-L2-01-02, so acceptance rests on the automated checks below; no human item is requested.
reviewer.scope: exercised through the controller API and the pure parser, not through the window

checks_run: RED: the new parser's unit tests failed first (Angle=NaN was classified as 'option value' instead of 'finite option number': NaN has no leading digit, so the split never reached the number path), and the hand-written session parser had accepted only an exactly-spelled BothSides key. GREEN: 5 passed; 0 failed for the session-level fixture file.
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test command_options_and_repeat -> 5 passed; 0 failed (005: 4 positive cases, 10 negative cases; option_parser unit tests 4/4 in the lib group)
cargo test -p om9-app --lib: 87 passed (includes the 4 option_parser unit tests)
cargo test --workspace -j 2: every group ok; cargo check --workspace --all-targets: exit 0
cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0
code_change: option_parser.rs (new, pure): OptionValue { Flag, Number { value_mm, radians } }, ParsedOption, parse_option(operation, text).
option_parser.rs reads the declared names through Operation::option, so an unknown option is refused with Unsupported('command option') and the reported name is the declared spelling.

option_parser.rs: units mm/cm/m/in for lengths and deg for angles; NaN, Infinity and an overflowing literal are refused as Invalid('finite option number'); an unknown unit is Unsupported('option unit'); an empty value is Missing('option value'); an empty name is Invalid('option name').
session.rs: line_descriptor() declares the LINE command (id 'line', feature LINE, aliases Line/Ln, options BothSides/Length, preconditions needs_document + needs_active_view).
session.rs: submit_geometry_text routes an assignment through the parser; BothSides sets the flag, Length fixes the end point's distance while the click chooses the direction.
